NONE: B1 further away in the distance (than something)
更遠；遠於
B1 outside or after (a stated limit)
（範圍）超出…；超過…
C2 too great or bad for anyone to believe, repair, recognize, etc.
太…而難以置信（無法修復，難以辨認等）
› If a legal case or a person's guilt is proved beyond reasonable doubt, there is enough proof for the person accused of a crime to be judged guilty.
（案件或罪行）證據確鑿的，確實的
C1 informal If something is beyond you, you are unable to understand it.
令…無法理解；非…所能及

example: In the distance, beyond the river, was a small town.
在河對岸的遠處有一座小鎮。
From the top of the hill we could see our house and the woods beyond.
站在這個小山頭，能看到我們的房子和遠處的森林。
Few people live beyond the age of a hundred.
很少有人活過100歲。
We cannot allow the work to continue beyond the end of the year.
我們不能允許這項工作拖延到下一年。
I've got nothing to tell you beyond (= in addition to) what I told you earlier.
除了先前告訴你的事情，我沒有別的可說了。
The repercussions will be felt throughout the industry and beyond (= in other areas).
影響將波及整個產業及其他領域。
Tonight's performance has been cancelled due to circumstances beyond our control (= events that we are unable to deal with).
由於出現了一些我們無法控制的情況，今晚的演出取消了。
She has always lived beyond her means (= spent more than she has earned).
她生活總是入不敷出。
His thoughtlessness is beyond belief.
他的輕率舉止令人感到不可思議。
He survived the accident, but his car was damaged beyond repair.
他在車禍中倖存，但他的車卻徹底撞毀了。
Her guilt was established beyond reasonable doubt.
她的罪行確鑿無疑。
Physics is completely beyond me.
恐怕我根本就學不會物理。

NONE: › mainly UK If something is beyond a joke, it has stopped being funny and is now a serious matter.
超出開玩笑的限度；令人極為難堪（或氣憤）

example: I used to think he was funny, but his behaviour has now gone way beyond a joke.
我曾經以為他滑稽有趣，但他現在所做的已不是開玩笑的問題了。

NONE: C2 If you know or believe something beyond a shadow of a doubt, you are certain that it is true.
確實；不容置疑

example: He is responsible beyond a shadow of a doubt.
毫無疑問，這應該由他負責。

NONE: C2 Something that is beyond compare is so good that nothing can be compared to it.
無可比擬，無與倫比

example: Her beauty is beyond compare.
她的美貌無可比擬。

NONE: › after death
死後

example: Do you think there's life beyond the grave?
你認為人死後有來生嗎？

NONE: › If someone's behaviour is beyond the pale, it is unacceptable.
越軌的，出格的；無法接受的

example: Her recent conduct is beyond the pale.
她最近的表現讓人難以接受。

NONE: C2 to a degree or in a way you had never thought possible
超過所望，出乎意料

example: Suddenly she was rich beyond her wildest dreams.
她突然出乎意料地發了大財。
The plan succeeded beyond my wildest dreams.
計畫居然出乎我意料地成功了。

NONE: › impossible/possible
不／可能的

example: It's not beyond the realm of possibility that some schools may have to cut sport altogether.
有些學校可能不得不完全砍掉體育課，這並非完全不可能。

NONE: › too many to count
多不勝數，不計其數

example: An earthquake in the city could result in deaths beyond number.
城市發生地震可能導致無數人死亡。
